description: This file defines the Logger class for the PhpSpreadsheet calculation engine. It manages debug logging, including enabling/disabling logs, echoing logs, and storing log entries, as well as handling a stack of cell references during calculations.

classes.name: Logger
classes.description: A class responsible for managing debug logs within the PhpSpreadsheet calculation engine, including writing, merging, and clearing logs, and controlling debug output settings.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the Logger with a CyclicReferenceStack instance.

methods.name: setWriteDebugLog
methods.description: Enables or disables the writing of debug logs.

methods.name: getWriteDebugLog
methods.description: Returns whether debug logging is enabled.

methods.name: setEchoDebugLog
methods.description: Enables or disables echoing of debug logs.

methods.name: getEchoDebugLog
methods.description: Returns whether echoing of debug logs is enabled.

methods.name: writeDebugLog
methods.description: Writes a message to the debug log, optionally echoing it if enabled.

methods.name: mergeDebugLog
methods.description: Merges multiple log entries into the debug log.

methods.name: clearLog
methods.description: Clears all entries from the debug log.

methods.name: getLog
methods.description: Returns the current debug log entries.
